As the host of a literary TV show, Georges begins receiving anonymously filmed videos of his family alongside cryptic, disturbing drawings, but as the tapes become increasingly intimate, they reveal a stalker who has known him for a very long time.

Release rollout

Caché opened first in France on October 5, 2005. The rollout continued across 27 countries, finishing in Japan on June 3, 2006. In the United States, it arrived in theaters on December 23, 2005.
